subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Count forwards in 10s, 5s and 2s from any multiple of 10, 5 or 2 within the same ranges; see the relationship with addition (more than, ascending order)

show.line: Count in twos! Two, four, six, eight, ten. Count in tens! Ten, twenty, thirty. Fast counting!

rounds.prompt: Count in twos. Two, four, six, and then?
Count in tens with me. Ten, twenty, thirty. What comes next?
Count the socks in twos. How many socks?
rounds.praise: Ten socks! Two, four, six, eight, ten.

rounds.prompt: Count in fives. Five, ten, fifteen, and then?
Count in tens. Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, and then?
Each hand has five fingers. Count in fives. How many fingers?

hints: Twos: say every second number. Two, four, six.
Tens end in zero. Ten, twenty, thirty, forty.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count in twos.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five is not in the twos. Two, four, six, eight.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Two, four, six, eight, ten!

parent_line: Can count in twos, fives and tens up to 50.
